a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: Enter, Space.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{id: string; title: ReactNode; content: ReactNode}>
props.description: The sections. Built on native <details>/<summary>, so opening, closing, keyboard and find-in-page come from the browser and the component ships no JavaScript at all. Several can be open at once: exclusivity would need the `name` attribute, and hiding what someone just opened is rarely what they wanted.

props.name: variant
props.description: surface puts the items in a card, with the line at 94% and the neutral hover.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Lets several items stay open. Without it, opening one closes the other, as in the reference.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The ids of the items that start open.

props.name: indicator
props.description: How opening is drawn: the arrow at the end, or a plus in a circle that turns 45° into a yellow × when the item opens (the FAQ of this site).

props.name: size
props.description: lg is the 60-tall row with body-size (16) text, 22 from the edge, for questions that stand alone.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin.
